_note: Voices and dates for works that are not Jung's. `voice` says whose words a cite is (the interface names it: Crowley, Burt, Neumann …; absent means Jung). `year`/`display` date an attestation by a work the field holds no engagement years of: Jung's own volumes carry theirs in the vault's cites and need no entry. The year is the work's first publication, read off its copyright page in the corpus (the English edition's year is kept in the display where it differs).
_schema: Each key is a Work id. `aliases` are the other cite keys for the same text (a cite resolves through them). `kind` is the vocabulary checked by scripts/works-registry.mjs. `author` is a person id (curation/people.json where it has one); `with` and `editor` name a second person where the title page gives one. `corpus` is the file under public/data/corpus/ (null where the text has no corpus volume). `lens` is set only where the Work has its own reading lens (cw09ii: aion; liber-novus: redbook). `yearSource` names the corpus page (p.N) that states `year`; a collected volume's copyright line dates the edition, not the work, so Jung's collected volumes carry no year here (the cites date them). Only the fields above are read by scripts/ingest.mjs and scripts/lib/attest.mjs (`voice`, `year`, `display`); a record added without a voice adds none to its cites.
